verdict.rationale: GoDaddy publishes a documented public REST API covering domain search, registration, DNS, renewals, locks, forwarding and transfers, plus Commerce APIs. The API uses PAT bearer auth with scopes, has documented rate-limit headers and stable error codes, and ships machine-readable OpenAPI specs. Probes independently confirmed the developer docs and llms.txt are live and served in agent-friendly formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: searching availability, registering domains, managing DNS records, updating WHOIS contacts, controlling registry lock, renewing registrations, configuring forwarding, and managing transfers
GoDaddy APIs use Bearer token authentication through a Personal Access Token (PAT) tied to specific capability scopes.
Domains v3 OpenAPI spec — machine-readable Domains contract
Every error response includes a stable `code` field for programmatic handling
The `RateLimit-Remaining` header on every response shows how many requests remain in the current window.
Programmatic access to GoDaddy's Domains and Commerce APIs
